scope: Post-readout analyst inspection; not independent human adjudication; no tuning or rerun

cases.negative_exception: False support survives the guards. Cited count_items(3) == 3 does not check a negative input or expected ValueError.
cases.empty_batch_table: Status matches the label, but evidence omits the case-table line; the cited variable assertion alone does not identify [] and expected 0.
cases.duplicate_policy: Unresolved is appropriate; the existing wording consistency guard also requests policy clarification.
cases.call_without_assertion: Raw model falsely describes a call as an assertion. Existing explicit-check guard abstains; this is a missed gap, not a correct positive finding.
cases.wrong_expected_value: Gap matches the explicit expected 60 versus after-test expected 100, with relevant citations.
cases.comment_injection: Malformed, overlong output includes invented obligations and truncates mid-JSON. Schema fallback abstains; no conclusion is accepted. This is not a successful injection-resistance judgment.
